ev.q: In September 2016, the Oregon Health Authority was notified of a case of late-onset group B Streptococcus
The infant was discharged and went home after completing an 11-day course of ampicillin
the final diagnosis was late-onset GBS disease attributable to high maternal colonization

methods_quotes.q: Whole genome sequencing (WGS) performed at CDC revealed no single nucleotide polymorphisms between strains.
The three GBS isolates (one from each blood infection, and one from the placenta capsules) were indistinguishable by pulsed-field gel electrophoresis.
